info.title: x-loadgen API
info.description:
HTTP API for the x-loadgen load-test daemon.

## Authentication

The login token is the only long-lived credential. It never expires on its own and changes only on password change or `reset-passwd`.

- Scripts: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (the login token itself, not a session).
- Browser: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` sets an HttpOnly cookie `x_loadgen_token` (SameSite=Lax, Path=/, no Secure, no Max-Age).
- `--no-auth` / `X_LOADGEN_NO_AUTH=1` disables authentication (for local labs only).
- Before the first password change, business endpoints return 403 `password_change_required`.

## Errors

Unless noted (the `/verdict` endpoint returns a Verdict body), errors use:

```json
{
  "error": { "code": "not_found", "message": "..." }
}
```

Stable codes: `unauthorized` (401), `password_change_required` (403), `invalid_request` (400), `auth_disabled` (400), `not_found` (404), `conflict` (409), `wait_timeout` (409), `internal` (500).

## Automation

Start from a template (`template` id or name) with optional overrides and `assert`. Poll `/stats` or `/windows`, `PATCH /traffic` to adjust QPS, `POST /stop` to finish a loop run, then `GET /verdict` (use `curl -f`) and download `/report.json` or `/report.html`. Loop runs continue in the daemon if the client disconnects.

servers.description: The process that serves this document.

post.summary: Verify the login token and set the auth cookie
post.description: The login token is the long-lived credential. It is echoed in the response and set as an HttpOnly cookie (`x_loadgen_token`, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, no Secure, no Max-Age). The token never expires on its own. Scripts may skip login and send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` directly.
Clears the cookie. The login token itself stays valid.

Requires the current token (cookie or Bearer) and `old_token`. The new token must be at least 24 characters of printable ASCII, without whitespace, quotes, semicolons, commas or backslashes, and must differ from the old token. On success the cookie is replaced and the old token is rejected immediately. `admin.passwd` is deleted after the first change.

get.description: With `--no-auth`, returns `auth_required: false` without a token. Otherwise requires a valid login token.

get.summary: Version, caps, and running traffic totals

post.summary: Create a target, optionally with tenants and products

post.description: For `protocol=mazbri`, encryption and optional request-binding fields are validated against the client contract. For `protocol=http`, only plaintext (`encryption_mode=none`) is accepted.
The private key is stored on the tenant; the response returns only the public key (and kid/alg) for registration in management.

alg.description: Signing algorithm, e.g. ed25519, ecdsa-p256-sha256, sm2-sign, rsa-pkcs1v15-sign-sha256, hmac-sha256.

post.summary: Start a run from a saved template
post.description: Identify the template with `template` (id or unique name) and/or `template_id` (id). Optional fields override the saved template for this run only. Optional `assert` is frozen in the snapshot and evaluated at the end (and on demand while running). Query `wait=true` holds the request until the run finishes or `timeout` seconds (default 60, max 600) elapse. A timeout returns 409 with `error.code=wait_timeout` and the current `run`. Loop runs continue in the daemon regardless of the client connection.

get.summary: Run detail with a redacted snapshot and verdict

delete.summary: Delete a non-running run and its directory

get.summary: Live or last-known counters and percentiles
Second-level ring buffer (empty after the process drops it)

get.description: Body is always a Verdict. HTTP status is chosen so `curl -f` yields a usable exit code: 200 for `pass` or `none` (no assert), 422 for `fail`, 409 for `pending` (still running or stopping). Loop runs do not finish on their own; stop them first, then call this endpoint.

post.summary: Resume a stopped or interrupted run

get.summary: Server-sent events with a stats snapshot once a second

token.description: The same login token that was submitted.

encryption_mode.description: none, request (encrypt request only), or full (encrypt request and decrypt response).

suite.description: Named suite, e.g. tenant-default-2026-11, gm-sm4-hmac-sm3, tenant-chacha20.

binding_key.description: Private key or HMAC secret; stored, never listed.

requests.description: Exactly one of requests or duration_secs.

AssertSpec.description: Optional SLA thresholds. Omitted fields are not checked. Comparisons are inclusive. Latency is milliseconds. max_error_rate is failure/samples (0–1). min_qps_ratio is achieved_qps/configured_qps, where achieved_qps is samples/elapsed_seconds over the wall-clock from started_at to ended_at (or now).

CreateRunRequest.description: Provide `template` (id or name) and/or `template_id` (id). Other fields override the saved template for this run only.
